name: disable_object_control

stack.evidence: func_001EB9A8 consumes one object ID, resolves it through func_001EAB00, queues object operation type 14 when found, and decrements Script stackTop by one

notes: The embedded operation-name table labels type 14 CONTROL_OFF, and its dispatcher sets the object's control-disable flag 0x100000000 and clears object-state flag 0x4. This is the singular-object counterpart of command 151 disable_all_object_control and the inverse of command 377 enable_object_control.
